body:
Self-contained specification for zero-ask 5-column policy enforcement across send_command_input, manage_task, and subagent tools (predecessor tickets have already exported normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args) -> { ok, folded, raw, reason } in hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs):

1. `hooks/policy/constants.mjs`:
   - Export `STDIN_TOOLS = new Set(['send_command_input'])`.
   - Export `SUBAGENT_TOOLS = new Set(['invoke_subagent', 'define_subagent', 'manage_subagents'])`.
   - Export `SUBAGENT_PROSE_KEYS = new Set(['Prompt', 'prompt', 'SystemPrompt', 'systemprompt', 'Description', 'description', 'Role', 'role', 'toolAction', 'toolaction', 'toolSummary', 'toolsummary'])`.

2. `hooks/policy/evaluate.mjs`:
   - Integration with `stepOne(name, args, ctx)` (lines 329–376):
     1. Run `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(args)` at the top of `stepOne` first (denying immediately when `!norm.ok`).
     2. Right after `if (name === 'run_command') return PASS;`, also return `PASS` when `STDIN_TOOLS.has(name)` or `(name === 'manage_task' && norm.folded.action === 'send_input')`, because `Input` is shell/REPL text inspected by `evaluateSendCommandInput` / `evaluateOrchestrationTool` via `classifyRunCommand` + non-`Input` path scanning.
     3. In the `else` branch of `stepOne` (where `topLevelSkipKeys` is selected for `swarm` and `WORKFLOW_TOOLS`), add `SUBAGENT_PROSE_KEYS` when `SUBAGENT_TOOLS.has(name)` (and skip `'Message'`/`'message'` for `'send_message'`) so prose fields mentioning rail filenames do not trigger false path denials in `stepOne`.
   - Export `evaluateSendCommandInput(rawArgs, ctx)` and wire `if (STDIN_TOOLS.has(name)) return evaluateSendCommandInput(args, ctx);` in `evaluatePayload` (after `stepOne`):
     1. Cols 1 (`ctx.readonly`) and 2 (`ctx.workerTicket`) -> `deny('Headless agb worker session cannot use send_command_input')` (even when `Terminate === true`).
     2. Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> `deny(norm.reason)`). Closed folded keys: `{ commandid, input, terminate, waitms, waitmsbeforeasync, toolaction, toolsummary }` (`commandid` if present must be non-empty string; `terminate` if present must be boolean; `input` if present must be string; `waitms`/`waitmsbeforeasync` if present must be finite number; any other key -> `deny(...)`).
     3. Inspect anchor repos `anchorRepos = ctx.anchors.map((a) => ctx.repoAt(a))`:
        - If `norm.folded.terminate === true && (norm.folded.input === undefined || norm.folded.input === '')`:
          - If `anchorRepos.some((r) => r.adlc && !r.store.ok)` -> `deny('ADLC ticket store corrupt or unreadable; frozen rails cannot be verified')`.
          - Otherwise -> `PASS` across Cols 3, 4, and 5.
        - Otherwise (non-empty `Input` or `Terminate !== true`):
          - In Col 3 (`anchorRepos.some((r) => r.adlc && (r.activeRail || !r.store.ok))`) -> `deny('Interactive stdin write forbidden while ADLC rails are active or store is unreadable')`.
          - In Cols 4 & 5: scan non-`Input` fields via `scanPathLike(rawArgs, { topLevelSkipKeys: new Set(['Input', 'input', 'toolAction', 'toolaction', 'toolSummary', 'toolsummary']) })` and check every resolved candidate via `gateOnePath(r, ctx, { rootIsTarget: false })` + `matchRoot` against `protectedRoots` and `boosterDataRoots` (any hit -> `deny`); then run `shVerdict = classifyRunCommand({ CommandLine: String(norm.folded.input ?? ''), Cwd: ctx.workspacePaths[0] }, ctx)` (already imported from `./shell.mjs` at line 24): return `PASS` **iff** `shVerdict.decision === 'pass'`, and `deny(shVerdict.reason ?? 'send_command_input denied by shell policy')` whenever `shVerdict.decision === 'deny' || shVerdict.decision === 'ask'` (`0` `ask` outputs!).
   - Update `evaluateOrchestrationTool(name, rawArgs, ctx)` (lines 497–524):
     - Preserve existing `'swarm'` handling verbatim when `name === 'swarm'`, and preserve `return PASS;` for `'schedule'` and `'send_message'` (after `stepOne` has already verified `normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive` and `boosterDataRoots`/`protectedRoots`).
     - Branch explicitly when `name === 'manage_task'`:
       1. Validate `norm = normalizeArgsCaseInsensitive(rawArgs)` (`!norm.ok` -> `deny(norm.reason)`).
       2. Require `action = norm.folded.action` to be one of `'list' | 'status' | 'kill' | 'send_input'`; missing or unknown `Action` -> `deny('Unsupported or missing manage_task Action')` across all 5 columns.
       3. `'list' | 'status'`: return `PASS` across all 5 columns (`stepOne` already checked `boosterDataRoots`/`protectedRoots`).
       4. `'kill'`: Cols 1 & 2 (`ctx.headless`) -> `deny('Headless agb worker session cannot kill tasks')`; Cols 3, 4, 5 -> if `ctx.anchors.some((a) => { const r = ctx.repoAt(a); return r.adlc && !r.store.ok; })` return `deny('ADLC ticket store corrupt or unreadable; frozen rails cannot be verified')`, else `PASS`.
       5. `'send_input'`: require `typeof norm.folded.input === 'string'` (`else deny(...)`); Cols 1, 2, and 3 (`ctx.headless || ctx.anchors.some((a) => { const r = ctx.repoAt(a); return r.adlc && (r.activeRail || !r.store.ok); })`) -> `deny('manage_task send_input forbidden in headless worker or active-rail ADLC repository')`; Cols 4 & 5 -> scan non-`Input` fields via `scanPathLike` + `gateOnePath`/`matchRoot`, then call `classifyRunCommand({ CommandLine: norm.folded.input, Cwd: ctx.workspacePaths[0] }, ctx)`, returning `PASS` iff `decision === 'pass'` and `deny(...)` on `'deny'` or `'ask'`.
     - Branch explicitly when `SUBAGENT_TOOLS.has(name)` (`'invoke_subagent' | 'define_subagent' | 'manage_subagents'`):
       1. Cols 1 & 2 (`ctx.headless`) -> `deny('Headless agb worker session cannot spawn or manage subagents')`.
       2. Cols 3, 4, 5 -> First check anchor store integrity ONLY (`if (ctx.anchors.some((a) => { const r = ctx.repoAt(a); return r.adlc && !r.store.ok; })) return deny('ADLC ticket store corrupt or unreadable; frozen rails cannot be verified');` — do NOT deny merely because `r.activeRail === true` on an anchor when no rail path is referenced, so `run(name, {}, fx.active)` in `test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs:106-108` continues to return `'pass'`!). Next run `const scan = scanPathLike(rawArgs, { topLevelSkipKeys: SUBAGENT_PROSE_KEYS });` (`if (scan.overflow) return OVERFLOW;`) and for every `token` in `scan.paths`, resolve via `resolveAll(token, ctx)` (denying if `resolved.length === 0`) and check `gateOnePath(r, ctx, { rootIsTarget: false })` on both `r` and `{ ...r, real: r.lexical }` (if any `verdict.decision !== 'pass'`, return `deny(verdict.reason)`), else return `PASS`.

3. Non-Mutating Bundle-Freshness Test (`test/plugin-layout.test.mjs`):
   - Add a test in `test/plugin-layout.test.mjs` that bundles `hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs` with `esbuild` into a temporary file inside `mkdtempSync` (using the exact banner/define/platform/format options from `package.json` `scripts['build:hooks']`) and asserts byte-for-byte equality with committed `dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs` without mutating the working tree.

4. Golden Cross-Column Suite (`test/policy-1-5-9-stdin-subagents.test.mjs`):
   - Exhaustively test all 5 context columns (1: `readonly`, 2: `workerTicket`, 3: interactive ADLC with active rails or corrupt store, 4: interactive ADLC without active rails, 5: interactive non-ADLC) across `send_command_input` (terminate & non-terminate), `manage_task` (`list`, `status`, `kill`, `send_input`, missing/unknown `Action`), and `invoke_subagent`/`define_subagent`/`manage_subagents` (including prose mentioning `lib/lock.mjs` passing in Col 3 while path arg `'lib/lock.mjs'` denies in Col 3), plus read-only inspection of existing `test/fixtures/agy-1.5.9-init-tools.json` (60 tools — do NOT edit the fixture) under Col 1 and Col 2, asserting zero `'ask'` outputs across these tools and verifying `classifyRunCommand` parity (e.g. `Input: 'python3 -c "open(\"lib/lock.mjs\",\"w\")"'` and `Input: 'rm -rf /tmp/x'` both return `'deny'` in Cols 4 & 5).
   - Run `npm run build && npm test && npm run plugin:validate`.

edges.contract: T3 completes all hooks/policy/* changes, rebuilds dist/**, and adds esbuild bundle-freshness verification in test/plugin-layout.test.mjs. T4 modifies only lib/*, bin/agb.mjs, dist/**, website/generated/**, test/fixtures/fake-agy, test/agy.test.mjs, test/doctor.test.mjs, and test/agy-1-5-9-print.test.mjs without touching hooks/**.

title: Enforce zero-ask 5-column policy matrix for send_command_input, manage_task, and subagents
